d: Long, wavy teal hair with voluminous curls and loose bangs frames a mature, young-adult face with narrow, golden-yellow eyes. The slender build is dressed in a metallic silver cocktail dress with a criss-cross bodice, paired with a short white cropped jacket with red lining and long black fingerless gloves. Silver metallic boots with sculptural, swirling vine-like accents rise to the mid-calf. A small, slender snake with a white underbelly and brown scales is draped around the neck and shoulders.
